steward: Knowledge Systems Lab, University of Michigan
release_authority: Knowledge Systems Lab, University of Michigan
review_status: Final Version 1.0; implementation-ready specification; not clinically validated or approved for clinical use

governance_process.change_control: Record and impact-classify every proposed change; released content is not modified in place.
governance_process.review_dossier: Preserve the proposal, rationale, sources, dependency evidence, compatibility impact, risks, affected requirements, and exact artifact fingerprints.
governance_process.required_review: Require an identified technical reviewer and, when clinical meaning may change, an identified qualified clinical-domain reviewer.
governance_process.regression_gate: Require the complete canonical fixture suite and every affected schema, dependency, provenance, replay, and presentation test to pass without waiver, skip, quarantine, or unexplained difference.
governance_process.approval: Require a specifically identified release approver acting for the release authority; the technical reviewer cannot be the sole final approver.
governance_process.publication: Publish the immutable new specification version, manifests, evidence, approval record, fingerprints, effective date, and supersession relationship atomically; preserve prior versions.
governance_process.rollback: Restore a complete previously approved release and record the reason; never mix versions.
governance_process.periodic_review: Review dependency currency and continuing fitness before every release and at an interval documented in the applicable release record.
